about.description: Binaryx is a real estate investment platform that offers fractional exposure to income-producing properties, marketed with a focus on stable rental yield. The platform sources, structures, and manages properties end-to-end, then provides investors access to property-linked positions with periodic income distributions and an option to exit via secondary liquidity where available. It targets smaller ticket sizes compared to traditional real estate ownership.
about.registryInfo: Binaryx Protocol DAO LLC – U.S. limited liability company that operates the Binaryx Platform (per Binaryx platform documentation).
